question: Which Indian musician is the first singer to get the highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M.S. Subbulakshmi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **M.S. Subbulakshmi** is the** first Indian musician** to receive the **Bharat Ratna**, the highest civilian honour in India.
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi was a renowned Carnatic vocalist.
 
• She was awarded the Bharat Ratna in **1998**.
